newsitem.title: EGYPT: Agip unit finds more gas off Nile Delta.
newsitem.headline: Agip unit finds more gas off Nile Delta.

text.p: The International Egyptian Oil Company (IEOC) found gas this month at a new well in the Timsah concession block in the Mediterranean off Port Said, oil industry sources said on Tuesday.
The Abu Seif-1 well tested at 10.2 million cubic feet a day and IEOC, the Egyptian affiliate of the Italian oil company Agip SpA, believes it is part of a new gas field, they said.
IEOC is the operator in the concession, which it shares with the U.S. company Amoco.
"The discovery confirms the potential of this Pleiocene target," one source said.
The well is close to the Waqar gas field, which is already producing, and it would not take long to link the well into the existing production infrastructure, the sources said.
The gas fields off the Nile Delta are developing into what oil executives call a world-class gas production area.
